title: karpatiosorbus holubyana
intro: Karpatiosorbus holubyana, commonly known as the Carpathian rowan or Holuby's rowan, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Karpatiosorbus holubyana include antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant actions, which have been attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain and swelling, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
